text: Creating a comprehensive inventory of services that are delivered by the City of Toronto to the public and are offered in French is feasible, but will require staff to be reassigned away from their current duties.

The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Economic and Community Development Committee request the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, to consider including the creation of an inventory of City-delivered services in French in the division’s work plan for 2025.
